note: A single site at the wooded edge of an open field, reached by a short gravel spur off Blacklog Valley Road near the Shade Bench Haul Road intersection. The booking page grades both the site and its driveway Moderate. Blacklog Valley Road is reached from US 522 near Orbisonia or from PA 35 near Reeds Gap. Picnic table and fire ring with grill; no toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 023 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, Horse/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 25 ft, pull-in gravel driveway, site and driveway graded Moderate, clearance 15 ft, picnic table; count 1 and 25 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on, PASDA leaf-off): a gravel spur about 45 m long leaves the road and runs along the south edge of a mown field to the pin at the tree line. NHD: Blacklog Creek 199 m away; not waterfront.
flags: ROAD / NAME: '(North Block)' is only the booking system's loop label. The page puts site 023 'near the intersection of Blacklog Valley Road and Shade Bench Haul Road' (the GIS notes add 'State Farm field'). Suggested name: 'Tuscarora State Forest Campsite 023 (Blacklog Valley Road)'. apply.py does not write names.

EQUIPMENT (rulings 4 and 8, reported not raised): the page lists 'Looking For Category: Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' with no 'RV Site' category; Max Vehicle Length 25, Site Access Drive-In. Kept.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Site Grade: Moderate', 'Driveway Grade: Moderate', gravel. Moderate is not Severe, so the site stays (ruling 2 as amended by 11); the agency grade is in the note and sites note, nothing measured. No caution line. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
LENGTHS (ruling 12 check): Max Vehicle Length 25 and Equipment Length 25; the page gives no driveway length and no spur figure, so nothing disagrees.
Overhead: 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 15' on every page of this entry; over the 10.5-ft line, nothing to act on.

ATV / SNOWMOBILE / HORSE (rulings 1, 12, 13, 14): no page and no GIS record of this entry contains the words ATV, snowmobile, noise, adjacent, trailhead, parking area or equestrian; nothing ties a site to an ATV system, an ATV or snowmobile lot, or a horse camp. The Tuscarora forest pages list no ATV trail (the /atv-riding page answers 404); the snowmobile page says only 'A snowmobile trail system of more than 100 miles'. The three snowmobile maps (elibrary 4818940, 3467448, 3467452) were downloaded but their parking symbols are image-only with no text layer naming lots: UNREAD for whether a lot sits at a site.
Ground: the pin is at the end of the visible spur, at the field's tree line, about 45 m east of the road; it stays (page and GIS agree at 40.37045,-77.73511).
Water: NHD has Blacklog Creek 199 m from the site; nothing within 50 m. Not waterfront, no lead.

Tuscarora advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office construction (mid-July to early November 2025), a chronic wasting disease notice, firewood. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice. The Tuscarora camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.' It names one equestrian area, Showaker; this entry is not in it.
